core_obligations: Boundedness: the base change is a bounded complex with coherent cohomology (proof line 4263)

Normalization: the base change statement identifies the internal hom from the residue field into the base change with the residue field of the source, which together with the local criterion gives finite injective dimension (proof lines 4264-4276)
Duality axiom: the same computation shows the double dual of the base change is the ring of the target (proof lines 4277-4281)
proof_roadmap: 由基变换引理 RHom_B(κ_B, ω_A^• ⊗_A B) = RHom_A(κ_A, ω_A^•) ⊗_A B = κ_A[0] ⊗_A B = κ_B[0]；由局部有限内射维数判据得 ω_A^• ⊗_A B 有限内射维数。
同理 RHom_B(ω_A^• ⊗_A B, ω_A^• ⊗_A B) = RHom_A(ω_A^•, ω_A^•) ⊗_A B = B ⇒ 归一化对偶复形的三条公理齐备。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the base change of a normalized dualizing complex along a flat local homomorphism with the same maximal ideal is a normalized dualizing complex for the target (author lemma at source lines 4254-4261, label lemma-flat-unramified). The proof (source lines 4263-4282) verifies the three axioms: boundedness immediately, finite injective dimension through the base change statement for the internal hom from the residue field and the local criterion, and the duality axiom by the same computation (proof lines 4263-4281). The residue field computation is the substance. H3.
